verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an HR/payroll SaaS like Justworks, but the evidence pack never documents a capability to act on many items at once, such as bulk editing employees, bulk imports, or batch API actions. The closest items are company-level default Xero mappings with department, office, or employee overrides, and automatic invoice sync. These are configuration defaults and scheduled sync, not user-invoked bulk operations, so they are adjacent at best. The OpenAPI probes also returned 404, so there is no evidence of a programmatic bulk surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
